# MakeMonmouth Code of Conduct

Our community is dedicated to providing a harassment-free, safe, and welcoming environment for everyone. This Code of Conduct is based on the principles outlined in our [MakeMonmouth Code of Conduct](https://docs.makemonmouth.co.uk/en/latest/code-of-conduct/) and applies to all spaces managed by MakeMonmouth.

## Our Standards

- **Respect:** Treat everyone with respect, regardless of differences in background or opinions.
- **Inclusivity:** Embrace diversity and foster an environment where everyone can contribute.
- **Constructive Feedback:** Offer thoughtful and constructive feedback.
- **Professionalism:** Maintain a professional tone in all interactions.

## Expected Behavior

- Be kind and courteous in all communications.
- Respect differing viewpoints and be open to discussion.
- Provide clear, constructive criticism when reviewing code or ideas.
- Follow the established guidelines and norms set forth by our community.

## Unacceptable Behavior

- Harassment, bullying, or discriminatory language or actions.
- Hate speech or any form of personal attacks.
- Disruption of the community’s collaborative efforts.
- Any behavior that creates an unsafe environment for members.

## Reporting and Enforcement

If you encounter or witness any behavior that violates this Code of Conduct, please report it immediately to [info@makemonmouth.co.uk] (info@makemonmouth.co.uk). All reports will be treated confidentially, and appropriate action will be taken to address any violations.

## Commitment

By participating in our community, you agree to uphold this Code of Conduct. We are committed to continuously improving our practices to ensure a positive experience for all members.

For further details and updates, please refer to our full guidelines at [MakeMonmouth Code of Conduct](https://docs.makemonmouth.co.uk/en/latest/code-of-conduct/).
